title: Hazard x exposure (published)
description: The canonical hazard-exposure product: hazard frequency crossed with crop, livestock and population exposure, by admin unit, scenario, model and severity. The largest single file the Atlas notebooks read.

transfer.rationale: Output of R/3; rebuild rather than move. The published copy on Atlas S3 is the distribution channel, not a sync route.

atlas_s3.note: Published per severity tier by scripts/r3_publish_tiers.R.

gaps: No CDH record yet, despite being the flagship published product.

changelog.change: Record created. Flagged the missing CDH record.
Acquisition recipe registered; this is now the only supported way to fetch it.
vop_nominal-usd21 republished from a full re-bake on native 0.25 deg exposure and clipped/median-filled crop prices.
vop_nominal-usd21 re-baked on the revised nominal crop price method (docs/methods/nominal_price_method.md).

Full rebake published: five variables (vop_nominal-usd21, vop_intld15-21, harv-area_ha, prod_t, head_n) x period jagermeyr + annual x 3 severities = 60 keys, 18-GCM sidecars. hazard_vars PTOT-L+NTxS+PTOT-G retired for PTOT-L+NTxM+PTOT-G; NDWS+NTxM+NDWL0 added. One CDH record per variable (africa-hazard-exposure-*).

vop_nominal-usd21 (both periods) republished: livestock nominal USD priced at national producer prices instead of the world median (+4.6 % continental, 0.43-2.2x per country-species); crop values identical. Linked cdh_record.

acquire.note: Computed by the pipeline, not downloaded. Listed so the catalogue names one reproducible command per dataset.
